title: Best Workout and Sports Headphones UK
short: Six workout headphones and earbuds tested through real gym sessions, runs and swims, from open-ear and bone-conduction designs to sweat-proof over-ear cans.
intro: Standard headphones tend to fall out, fog up with sweat or block out traffic noise you actually need to hear on a run. This guide is based on Men's Fitness UK's tested roundup (updated 15 September 2026), where testers Kieran Alger, Mike Sawh and Laurence McJannet wore each pair through real gym sessions, runs and swims, judging secure fit, sweat and water resistance, sound quality, battery life and, where relevant, workout-tracking accuracy.

products.name: AirPods Pro 3
products.best_for: iPhone users who want reliable workout tracking alongside excellent ANC
products.key_spec: IP57 rated, adaptive ANC, 8hr battery (24hr with case), Bluetooth 5.3, 5.5g per earbud
products.summary: Men's Fitness UK's top pick, calling workout tracking here the most reliable they've come across in any earbuds, a first for Apple. Noise cancellation blocks out gym and traffic noise even better than the previous generation, and Transparency mode lets sound back in cleanly when needed, in a tougher, more sweat-resistant design than before.

cons: Fit could still be problematic for some ears
Heart rate sensor mainly works with Apple apps

products.name: OpenSwim Pro
products.best_for: Swimmers and multi-sport athletes who want bone conduction with Bluetooth
products.key_spec: IP68 rated, bone conduction, 32GB MP3 storage, 9hr battery, Bluetooth 5.4, 27.3g
products.summary: Men's Fitness UK's tester wore these along roads and in both the pool and gym, finding them comfortable and secure, with decent sound quality for a bone conductor. The addition of Bluetooth alongside built-in MP3 storage is a genuine upgrade over earlier Shokz models, and they survived stress tests including high-heat exposure.
pros: Built-in 32GB MP3 storage for swimming without a phone
cons: Bluetooth battery life fell short of claims in testing

products.name: Ear 2
products.best_for: Buyers who want premium sound and style without the premium AirPods price
products.key_spec: IP54 (buds) / IP55 (case), adaptive ANC, 6.3hr battery (ANC off), Bluetooth 5.3, 4.5g per earbud
products.summary: Men's Fitness UK found these offer fantastic value at nearly half the price of the Apple AirPods Pro, balancing everyday use with workout demands. The 11.6mm drivers sounded great in testing, and the extended-stem design stayed secure even on steep runs, though physical press controls weren't the most responsive mid-run.

specs.Price guide: Roughly half the price of AirPods Pro (at time of writing)

pros: Fantastic value for the sound quality
cons: Physical controls not the most responsive on the run

products.name: RIPT Ultra
products.best_for: Buyers who want fully immersive sound and ANC for gym-only sessions
products.key_spec: IPX5 sweat-proof, adaptive ANC, swappable silicone/leather cushions, 50hr battery, 2-year warranty
products.summary: Men's Fitness UK rated this one of the most effective active noise cancellation implementations they've tried, so immersive that testers recommend it for gym-based workouts only rather than outdoor use where awareness of surroundings matters. Interchangeable, washable silicone and leather cushions are a standout feature, and the 50-hour battery easily covers a week of sessions.
cons: Buttons can be tricky to locate mid-workout
ANC is so immersive it's not suited to outdoor use

products.name: Tri Run
products.best_for: Buyers who want open-ear safety and waterproofing without a premium price
products.key_spec: IPX8 waterproof, bone conduction, open-ear design, 6hr battery
products.summary: Men's Fitness UK found this delivers a third of the price of market-leading bone conductors with sound, comfort and ease of use that hold up well against rivals costing three times as much. Testers highlighted how quickly you forget you're wearing them, a genuine plus over pricier open-ear alternatives, with battery life that exceeded expectations.
pros: Excellent value for an open-ear headphone
Comfortable, easy to forget you're wearing them
cons: Bass is a little thin, typical of open-ear designs

products.name: Ultra Open Earbuds
products.best_for: Buyers who want premium sound while staying fully aware of their surroundings
products.key_spec: IPX4, open-ear design, OpenAudio technology, up to 7hr battery, Bluetooth multipoint
products.summary: Men's Fitness UK called this the best-sounding open-ear buds they've tested, delivering rich, immersive audio while an innovative hook design keeps you fully aware of traffic and surroundings, ideal for road running or cycling. They can feel slightly unstable, and the price is steep, but the situational awareness genuinely works as intended.
pros: Keeps you aware of surroundings, ideal for road running
Versatile for workouts, commuting and work

guide.q: Open-ear, in-ear, or over-ear for workouts?
guide.a: Open-ear and bone-conduction designs like the Shokz or H2O Audio Tri Run leave your ear canal free, keeping you aware of traffic or gym surroundings, at some cost to bass depth. In-ear buds like the Nothing Ear 2 or Apple AirPods Pro 3 give richer sound and active noise cancellation for gym-only focus. Over-ear options like the H2O Audio RIPT Ultra offer the most immersive sound but are bulkier to carry.

guide.q: How much water resistance do I actually need?
guide.a: For general gym sweat, an IPX4 rating like the Bose Ultra Open Earbuds is usually enough. For running in the rain or open-water swimming, look for IP68 or IPX8 like the Shokz OpenSwim Pro or H2O Audio Tri Run, both fully submersible.

guide.q: Should I run with noise cancellation on?
guide.a: Men's Fitness UK specifically recommends the H2O Audio RIPT Ultra's strong ANC for gym-only use rather than outdoor running, since blocking out traffic noise on the road is a safety risk. For outdoor exercise, an open-ear design like the Bose Ultra Open Earbuds or Shokz keeps you aware of your surroundings by design.

guide.q: Do I need workout tracking built into the earbuds?
guide.a: Men's Fitness UK found the Apple AirPods Pro 3's workout and heart-rate tracking the most reliable of any earbuds tested, useful if you want one fewer device to carry. Most other options here rely on a separate watch or phone for tracking, which is perfectly fine if you already use one.
